meta.description: Gives the paths that pass through a color: white flesh, pink gills, a yolk-yellow chanterelle. Where paths of two colors meet in hyphae_to_mesh the color goes over smoothly. Paths without a color keep the viewer's material.

paths.description: The paths, they pass through with the color added

color.description: The color of the paths, set here or from a color node like mix_color to let it follow time. hyphae_to_mesh colors the surface around them with it
